issuer: the Alabama Law Enforcement Agency (ALEA), Driver License Division
note: ALEA's document requirements and fees page (read 2026-10-30) gives $36.25 to purchase a licence and $36.25 to purchase a non-driver identification card. The graduated licence page says Stage III, the unrestricted or regular licence, is held from 17 (after six months of Stage II), so a full licence is kept from 17. Neither term was found on the pages read (ALEA's licence and card pages state none), so both are null. No youngest age for the card was read.

sources.title: ALEA, Document Requirements and Fees
sources.said: $36.25 to purchase license (no checks) ... $36.25 to purchase non-driver identification card

sources.title: ALEA, Graduated Driver License
sources.said: Stage III (Unrestricted or Regular License) Must be age 17 or older.
